physicalNotes: Radius 0.884 Jupiter radii from Jordán et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163..125J), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..125J/abstract): 63,198.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.491 Jupiter masses (Jordán et al. 2022, the mass the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2022AJ....163..125J), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022AJ....163..125J/abstract) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.period: Jordán et al. 2022 (2022AJ....163..125J), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname JORD_AACUTE_N_ET_AL__2022): P 2.7886556 d

sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
